title: Pets.com: The Sock Puppet That Burned $300 Million

lines.text: February two thousand. Pets dot com is on top of the world.
It just raised eighty-two million dollars on the stock market.
The mascot? A sock puppet with a microphone. People loved him.
There was one small problem. Every bag of dog food cost them money to ship.
Nine months later, the whole company was dead.
